parameters.content:
## Setup before running
1. Point both Google Sheets nodes at your Lead Pool sheet (documentId + sheetName)
2. Attach your existing Google Sheets credential (same one Workflow A/B use)
3. In 'Update Lead Pool Row', set the matching column to whatever uniquely identifies a lead in your sheet (e.g. profile_url) - adjust the placeholder
4. Column 'name' must hold the lead's full name (e.g. 'Jane Smith') - this workflow splits it into first/last inside the Code nodes

nodes.name: SerpAPI Search
nodes.notes: Key supplied via the 'SerpApi Key' query-auth credential (param: api_key). Do not inline the key here.
